messagingAngle: Collaboration opportunity for supplement brands and manufacturers

emails.subject: Collaboration opportunity with a fast-growing contract manufacturer
emails.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I hope you're doing well.

I'm reaching out because I believe our companies could be a good fit to work together.

I'm the Founder & CEO of TS LAB®, a Slovenia-based contract manufacturer focused on capsule-based food supplements and bulk capsule manufacturing. We are GMP, HACCP, FDA registered, and Organic accredited, and manufacture for more than 50 supplement brands across Europe and internationally, giving us a broad market perspective and a global industry outlook.

Over the past few years, TS LAB® has become one of the fastest-growing companies in Slovenia, and we regularly exhibit at Vitafoods Europe, where we work closely with some of the industry's leading brands, Amazon retailers, pharmacy groups, and retail chains.

Because we manufacture for companies across multiple European markets, we gain a unique view of what's actually selling. Categories such as Longevity, Cognitive Health, Beauty-from-Within, and Gut Health continue to see exceptional growth. We regularly help our partners identify emerging areas, refine existing formulations, and introduce additional products to market quickly.

Whether you're looking to expand your product portfolio, improve manufacturing efficiency, increase margins, or simply add a reliable production partner, I'd be happy to explore whether we could create value together.

If you think it would be worthwhile, I'd be delighted to arrange a short chat and exchange ideas.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Tilen Suhadolnik

Founder & CEO | TS LAB®
